verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe built-in deployment protection that controls who can open preview and production URLs with passwords. That is the story's core: password-gating a deployed site without building custom auth. The evidence is a single summary line with no configuration detail. Missing for 10: setup and configuration documentation for password protection, plan availability and pricing, scope options (per-environment or per-deployment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system

citations.quote: Control who can open your preview and production URLs with Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs.
